item.title: OpenCV
item.description:
问题(libSM.so.6 缺失)#

运行opencv的代码时，报以下错误：#

Traceback (most recent call last):
 File "data_generator.py", line 24, in <module>
 import cv2
 File "/usr/local/lib/python3.5/dist-packages/cv2/__init__.py", line 3, in <module>
 from .cv2 import *
ImportError: libSM.so.6: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

解决#

原因是缺少共享文件库，解决办法如下：

  1. 安装apt-file $ apt-get update $ apt-get install apt-file $ apt-file update

  2. 寻找依赖库 $ apt-file search libSM.so.6

libsm6: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libSM.so.6 libsm6: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libSM.so.6.0.1

根据提示，安装合适的依赖库 $ apt-get install libsm6

  1. 其余文件缺失类似, 即可解决问题。
